skills.soulburn: The number of ++Dirge Bullets++ granted is doubled.

skills.name: Touch of Darkness
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with magic, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict --decreased Defense-- for 1 turn. **Cannot trigger a critical hit** or a heavy blow, and a successful attack will inflict **additional damage** proportional to the **caster's Attack**.
skills.soulburn: Increases effect chance to 100% and decreases Defense for 2 turns.

skills.name: Boundless Obsession
skills.description: **Reduces the effect of Combat Readiness increases provided by Speed** by 50%. At the start of the foremost ally's turn except for the caster, **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Eternal Lament
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a horde of illusions, **dispelling one buff** before **increasing cooldowns** by 1 turn and **decreasing Combat Readiness** by 30%. **Cannot trigger a critical hit** or a heavy blow, but **penetrates** the target's Defense by 50%.

skills.name: Insanity
skills.description: Claws the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Attack-- for 1 turn.

skills.name: Blood Feast
skills.description: All allies **absorb** {{variable}} of the damage they inflict as Health. Every time an enemy dies, all allies **recover** 20% Health and the caster's **Combat Readiness increases** by 10%. Effects upon enemy death can only be activated once per turn.

skills.name: Dirge
skills.description: Attacks with magic, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Swing
skills.description: Attacks with a staff, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict --burn-- for 1 turn, before **detonating burn** effects inflicted on the enemy at the end of the turn.

skills.name: Flame Barrier
skills.description: After being attacked, grants ++increased Attack++ and a ++barrier++ (proportional to Attack) for 1 turn, and inflicts --burn-- on the attacker for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flame Spurt
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a powerful fire, **dispelling two buffs** before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict two --burn-- effects for 1 turn.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, with a {{variable}} chance to --poison-- for 1 turn. When granted ++promotion++, damage dealt increases proportional to the **target's max Health**.

skills.name: Ambition
skills.description: At the start of the turn, when an enemy's Health is 50% or less, has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++exploiting weak points++ to the caster. When an enemy dies, grants ++promotion++ to the caster. Promotion can stack up to 6 times.

skills.name: Strike Target
skills.description: Attacks the enemy relentlessly, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict --target-- for 2 turns. When granted ++promotion++, damage dealt increases proportional to the **target's max Health**.

skills.name: Half Moon Slash / Waning Moon Slash
skills.description:
--(Rhianna)-- Attacks the enemy with a dagger, inflicting --erosion-- for 2 turns. A critical hit will **detonate erosion** effects inflicted on the target.

++(Luciella)++ After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy with a dagger and **absorbs** some of the damage dealt as health.

skills.name: Hunter's Mark / Blade of Pursuit
skills.description:
--(Rhianna)-- Attacks the enemy, **dispelling two buffs** before inflicting --bind-- and --decreased Defense-- for 2 turns. Swaps with Luciella and grants an **extra turn**. After attacking, when the target has a debuff, Luciella **activates Waning Moon Slash** as an extra attack.

++(Luciella)++ After granting ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 3 turns, attacks the enemy. Swaps with Rhianna and grants an **extra turn**. After attacking, when the target's Health is 50% or less, Rhianna **activates Half Moon Slash** as an extra attack.

skills.name: Pursuit of Death
skills.description: Rhianna and Luciella launch a coordinated attack. Luciella **attacks all enemies** and when the target is a Hero, **ignores damage sharing**. Rhianna **dispels two buffs** from all enemies, before inflicting --fear-- for 1 turn. ++One Butterfly's Afterdream++ will remain throughout the battle.

skills.name: Hemorrhage
skills.description: Cuts the enemy with dual-wielded swords, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Speed-- for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Speed**.

skills.name: Wind Slash
skills.description: Attacks with a swordstorm, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Attack-- for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Speed**.

skills.name: Moonlight Roar
skills.description: **Increases Combat Readiness** of all allies by {{variable}} through the power of the moon. Grants an **extra turn**.

skills.name: Quick Pierce
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns. When the caster is granted ++increase Speed++, effect chance increases by 25%.

skills.name: Cheer
skills.description: Encourages all allies, ++increasing Speed++ for 2 turns.
skills.soulburn: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

skills.name: Flash Cut
skills.description: **Decreases debuff duration** of all allies by 1 turns, and attacks **all enemies** with a shockwave, with a {{variable}} chance each to inflict --decreased Speed-- and --restrict-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.description: Attacks with a quick shot of an arrow. A critical hit will **decrease the caster's skill cooldown** by 1 turn.

skills.name: Lullaby Arrow
skills.description: Shoots an arrow infused with a sleep toxin, with a {{variable}} chance to put them to --sleep-- for 1 turn.

skills.name: War Hymn
skills.description: Encourages an ally except for the caster, **decreasing skill cooldowns** by 2 turns.

skills.name: Okay, Shall I Get Started?
skills.description: Cuts the enemy to attack, granting a ++random buff++ to the caster for 1 turn.

skills.name: Analyze and Assess
skills.description:
After attacking with a non-basic skill, **copies two buffs** when the target has a buff, **regardless of whether the attack hits**, and grants their effects to all allies. This effect is not applied to undispellable buffs. When an ally is attacked by an enemy who has a buff, **activates Be Ready!** against the attacker.
**Be Ready!**: Quickly approaches the enemy and attacks, **increasing Combat Readiness** of the caster by 30%.

skills.name: Devour It, Black Flame!
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with black flame, and a successful attack will inflict 5,000 **additional damage** to the target. Additional damage increases **proportional to the number of buffs** granted to all allies, up to 10,000. **Unaffected by elemental disadvantage**.
skills.soulburn: Cooldown of this skill is decreased by 2 turns.

skills.name: Ring Throw
skills.description: Throws rings at the enemy to attack, with a 75% chance to **dispel one buff**, and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 15%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Dazzling Dance
skills.description: Dazzles the enemy with a dance, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns, before a 50% chance to use Ring Throw. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Showtime
skills.description: With an elegant dance, **recovers Health** of all allies proportional to the **target’s max Health** before granting one ++random buff++ for 3 turns.
skills.soulburn: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

skills.name: Vital Point Slash
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a dagger. **Penetrates** the target's Defense, and **cannot trigger a critical hit**. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Speed**.

skills.name: Pickpocketing
skills.description: Swiftly attacks the enemy, **dispelling all buffs** before **decreasing Combat Readiness** by {{variable}} and inflicting --pilfer--. Grants ++increased Attack++ to the caster for 2 turns and an **extra turn**.

skills.name: Clumsy Finish
skills.description: Nimbly attacks the enemy. **Penetrates** the target's Defense, and **cannot trigger a critical hit**. After attacking, activates a security sensor by a mistake, dispelling all buffs from the caster and inflicting --stun-- for 1 turn, and deals 7000 **fixed damage** to all enemies. **Ignores Effect Resistance**.

skills.name: Stand Back!
skills.description: Attacks the enemy by firing a pistol and has a {{variable}} chance to --target-- them for 2 turns. When the caster is granted ++Hawk's Eye++, after attacking, **increases Combat Readiness** of the foremost ally by 20%.

skills.name: Devoted Support
skills.description:
When the foremost ally is attacked by a Single Attack, **decreases damage suffered** by {{variable}}. When more than one damage reduction effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied.
When the foremost ally's Health is 50% or less after being attacked, **dispels all debuffs** from the foremost ally and the caster, and grants ++Hawk's Eye++ to the caster for 2 turns. Dispelling debuffs and Hawk's Eye effects can only be activated once every 3 turns.

skills.name: All Out!
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with focused fire, **dispelling all buffs** and **decreasing Combat Readiness** by 50%, before granting ++immunity++ to the caster and the foremost ally for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fire Slingshot
skills.description: Attacks with a slingshot, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Attack-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fire Shockbomb
skills.description: Fires a shockbomb at the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns. **Decreases skill cooldown** of Go, Racoo! by 1 turn. At the end of the turn, **detonates** --bombs-- inflicted on the enemy.

skills.name: Go, Racoo!
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with Racoo’s help, **decreasing buff durations** by 1 turn before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict --decreased Speed-- and a --bomb-- for 2 turns. Grants ++skill nullifier++ once to the caster.

skills.name: Soul Purification
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a noble power, and grants a ++barrier++ (proportional to the **caster’s max Health**) to the ally with the lowest Health for 2 turns.
skills.soulburn: Grants a ++barrier++ to all allies for 2 turns after attacking.

skills.name: Vigilant Eye
skills.description: When an ally is attacked by an extra attack, counterattack, or Dual Attack, **recovers Health** of all allies proportional to the **caster’s max Health** and the **number of attacked allies**, and **increases Combat Readiness** of each by 5% per attacked ally.

skills.name: Noble Rekos
skills.description: With the grace of Rekos, grants a ++barrier++ (proportional to the **caster’s max Health**) and ++revive++ to all allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Neutralize
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a dagger and has a {{variable}} chance to inflict --bleed-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Clear The Back
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a grenade launcher, **dispelling two buffs** before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict two --burn-- effects for 1 turn. **Increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 50%.

skills.name: Say Hello To My Little Friends
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with her secret weapon and **extends durations of debuffs** except for those which prevent movement by 1 turn before a {{variable}} chance to inflict --decreased Defense-- for 2 turns. When this skill is not on cooldown, at the start of an ally’s **extra turn**, grants ++swift attack++ to the caster and **increases Combat Readiness** by 25%.
skills.soulburn: At the end of the turn, **detonates** bleed and burn effects inflicted on the target.

skills.name: Gravity Arrow
skills.description: Shoots gravity arrows at the enemy, **decreasing Combat Readiness** by {{variable}}, and **increasing Combat Readiness** of the caster by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Gravitation
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a magic circle, with a 50% chance each to **decrease Combat Readiness** by {{variable}} four times.
skills.soulburn: Skill cooldown is decreased by 2 turns.

skills.name: Event Horizon
skills.description: Shoots a powerful gravity sphere to attack **all enemies**, **dispelling all buffs** before inflicting --restrict-- for 2 turns. **Increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 50%.

skills.name: Hemorrhage
skills.description: Cuts the enemy with dual-wielded swords, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Speed-- for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Speed**.

skills.name: Wind Slash
skills.description: Attacks with a swordstorm, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Attack-- for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Speed**.

skills.name: Divine Response
skills.description: Corrects stance, **increasing Combat Readiness** of all allies by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Sequential Cutter
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword. When the caster's Health is 50% or more, has a {{variable}} chance to inflict --provoke-- for 1 turn, and when the caster's Health is less than 50%, grants ++increased Defense++ to the caster for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Defense**.

skills.name: Shield of Light
skills.description: Covers an ally with the Shield of Light, **dispelling two debuffs** and granting a ++barrier++ (proportional to the **caster's Defense**) for 2 turns before **increasing Combat Readiness** by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Goddess of Victory
skills.description: Gives blessing to all allies, ++increasing Attack++ for 1 turn, and **Combat Readiness** by {{variable}}.
skills.soulburn: Extends duration of buffs granted by this skill by 1 turn.

skills.name: Ignite
skills.description:
Attacks the enemy with flames, and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 15%. When used on the caster's turn, if the caster is granted ++Flame Alchemist++, activates Heat Wave instead of Ignite.
**Heat Wave**: Attacks the enemy with a huge flame, and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 30%. **Penetrates** the target's Defense by 50%. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

skills.name: Hero of Ishval
skills.description: At the start of the first battle, **gains 40 Fighting Spirit** and grants ++Flame Alchemist++. Damage suffered in one attack does not **exceed {{variable}} of max Health**.

skills.name: Scorching Heat
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a consecutive barrage of flames, and grants ++Flame Alchemist++ to the caster. When there are three or fewer enemies, **damage dealt increases with fewer enemies**.

skills.name: Key to an Oath
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a staff, before **recovering Health** of all allies. Damage dealt and amount recovered increase proportional to the **caster's max Health**.
skills.soulburn: Attacks the enemy before greatly **healing** all allies. Does not trigger a Dual Attack.

skills.name: Light Pillar
skills.description: Summons Light Pillar, **dispelling all debuffs** from an ally and **recovering their Health** before granting them a ++barrier++ and ++damage limit++ for 2 turns. Amount recovered and barrier strength increase proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Light Ascending
skills.description: **Dispels all debuffs** from an ally with healing magic before **recovering** Health by 50% and granting ++invincibility++ for 1 turn. When the target is already dead, **revives** them with 100% Health before the same effect is applied. At the start of the first battle, grants ++Spirit Lord's Protection++ to the caster.

skills.name: Liquidation
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a whip, and grants ++increased Speed++ to the caster for 1 turn. Deals **additional damage** equivalent to 50% of injuries inflicted on the target.

skills.name: Deflection
skills.description: Creates a gust of wind, **dispelling two buffs** from all enemies and **decreasing Combat Readiness** by {{variable}}, before **spreading** the selected target's debuffs. Grants ++stealth++ to the caster for 2 turns.

skills.name: Demolition
skills.description: Attacks the enemy by destroying the surroundings, **dispelling all buffs** from the target and **decreasing Combat Readiness** by 50% before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict --laceration-- and --silence-- for 2 turns. **Increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 50%. At the start of the first battle, grants ++stealth++ for 2 turns.

skills.name: Evil Spirit's Call
skills.description: Summons an evil spirit to attack the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to put the enemy to --sleep-- for 1 turn. When the target is asleep after the attack, **increases the caster's Combat Readiness** by 20%. This skill does not trigger a Dual Attack.

skills.name: Cloud of Ruin
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** by summoning storm clouds and has a {{variable}} chance to **dispel two buffs** before inflicting --sleep-- for 1 turn. When this skill is not on cooldown, at the end of an enemy’s turn, **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Eye of Death
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with the eyes of an evil spirit, and when the enemy is defeated, **extends debuff durations** of all remaining enemies by 1 turn. **Penetrates** the target’s Defense, but **cannot trigger a critical hit** or a heavy blow. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Corrupted Divinity
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, and triggers a **Dual Attack** from the ally with the highest Attack. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Salvation
skills.description:
Releases divinity, granting ++skill nullifier++ once to the caster, and **cloning** a target Hero except for the caster for 1 turn. Grants an **extra turn**.
**Clone**: Clones the target's appearance and abilities. While in the Clone state, seperate skill cooldowns are applied. When dispelled, unique effects granted to the caster by the Clone skill are also dispelled.

skills.name: Nggdrasil's Judgment
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with the power of Nggdrasil, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict --decreased Defense-- for 2 turns, and deals **additional damage** to the target. Damage dealt and additional damage increase proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Spirit Burst
skills.description: Attacks **two enemies** with a burst and has a {{variable}} chance to **dispel one buff**.
skills.soulburn: Increases effect chance to 100% and **ignores Effect Resistance**.

skills.name: Guidance of Nature
skills.description:
At the start of an ally's extra turn, **gains 2 Focus** and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 30%. After using a skill, when **Focus** is full, activates Wings of Liberation.
**Wings of Liberation**(**consumes 5 Focus**): Attacks **all enemies** by unleashing a spirit bird. **Increases Hit Chance** by 50% when using this skill, and is **unaffected by elemental disadvantage**.

skills.name: Blossoming Hope
skills.description: By kindling the light of hope, grants ++invincibility++ to all allies for 1 turn .

skills.name: Ankle Cut
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, with a {{variable}} chance to make them --unable to be buffed-- for 1 turn.

skills.name: Power of the Four Seasons
skills.description:
**Evasion increases** by {{variable}}, and after successfully evading, **counterattacks** with Blade Gust. Blade Gust can only be activated once every 2 turns.
**Blade Gust** (++Gains 10 Soul++): Attacks **all enemies** with a blade gust, **dispelling one buff**.

skills.name: Smite of Salvation
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a powerful blow. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts **extinction**. **Penetrates** the target's Defense by 50%.

skills.name: Is This How You Do It
skills.description: Attacks the enemy, and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster and the ally with the highest Attack except for the caster by {{variable}}.

skills.name: I Know a Thing About Poison
skills.description:
At the start of the turn, **dispels one debuff** each from two allies. After an enemy uses a skill, when an ally is inflicted with --poison-- or --venom--, **dispels all debuffs** from the caster and activates Cleanse.
**Cleanse**: **Dispels all debuffs** from all allies and grants ++immunity++ and ++indomitable++ for 1 turn, before **resetting skill cooldowns** of the caster.

skills.name: You May Walk Yourself Out
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies**, before granting a ++barrier++ (proportional to the **caster's max Health**) to all allies for 2 turns. Deals 5,000 **additional damage** regardless of whether the attack hits. When the caster is granted ++indomitable++, greatly increases additional damage.

skills.name: This'll Sting!
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a scalpel, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict two --bleeding-- effects for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, **detonates** bleeding effects inflicted on the target,
skills.soulburn: Grants an **extra attack** with the same skill.

skills.name: There, It'll Feel Better
skills.description:
At the start of the first battle, increases Attack proportional to max Health.
At the start of an ally's turn, **dispels one debuff** from the target and **recovers Health** proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: It's Time to Be Reborn!
skills.description: **Dispels all debuffs** from an ally except for the caster before fully **recovering Health**. Grants ++superhumanization++ to the target for 3 turns and **increases Combat Readiness** by 50%. This skill is **unaffected by cooldown increase and decrease effects**.

skills.name: Rapid Fire
skills.description: Attack the enemy with a pistol. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **target's max Health**. A critical hit will double the amount of Focus gained.

skills.name: Explosive Gentleman
skills.description: At the start of the first battle, **gains 3 Focus**. After making a critical hit, **increases Combat Readiness** of all allies except for the caster by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Rifle Shot
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a rifle. When **Focus** is full, **consumes it all**, increasing damage dealt.

skills.name: Graceful Gesture
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with phantoms, **dispelling one buff**. When the caster is ++enraged++, triggers a **Dual Attack** from the ally with the highest Attack.

skills.name: Phantom's Waltz
skills.description: **Decreases the amount of resources gained** by the enemy by 50%. At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, has a {{variable}} chance to grant ++stealth++ for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fanatic Ball
skills.description: Hosts a ball, making all allies ++enraged++ for 2 turns. **Dispels two buffs** from all enemies and --decreases Speed-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Repel
skills.description:
Attacks the enemy with a chain axe, with a {{variable}} chance to inflict --decreased Defense-- for 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, **activates Eradication** as an **extra attack**.
**Eradication**: Attacks the enemy, inflicting --bleed-- for 2 turns, and at the end of the turn, **detonates** --bleed-- effects inflicted on the target. **Ignores Effect Resistance**.

skills.name: Abyss Observer
skills.description: At the start of battle and at the end of the turn, grants ++stealth++ to the caster for 1 turn. At the end of someone's turn, when an enemy is inflicted with --provoke-- or --redirected provoke--, grants ++rage++ to the caster for 2 turns and **increases Combat Readiness** by {{variable}}.

skills.name: Unexpected Accident
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** by staging an accident, inflicting three --bleeding-- effects for 1 turn. When the target is inflicted with --provoke-- or --redirected provoke--, extends duration of --bleed-- inflicted on the target by 1 turn. When the caster is granted ++rage++, **ignores Effect Resistance**.

skills.name: Watch Out
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a fan, with a {{variable}} chance to --target-- the enemy for 1 turn.

skills.name: I'm with My Friends
skills.description:
For every surviving ally, **decreases damage suffered** by 10%. When more than one damage reduction effect of the same kind is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. When an ally is attacked, **gains 1 Focus**, and when the caster's stacked **Focus** is 5, **consumes all Focus** and activates You're Not Cute.
**You're Not Cute**: Attacks **all enemies** with a fan, with a 75% chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Haven't I Warned You?
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** with a spray of water, **dispelling all buffs** before a {{variable}} chance each to inflict --cannot buff-- and --unhealable-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Spear of Vengeance
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a spear, with a {{variable}} chance to --provoke-- for 1 turn. When it is not the caster's turn, effect chance increases by 25%.

skills.name: Indomitable Spirit
skills.description:
Increases Attack by 30% and **Critical Hit Resistance** by {{variable}}. When attacking, **cannot trigger a critical hit** or a heavy blow. When attacked, if the caster suffers a non-critical hit, **inflicts damage on the attacker** proportional to the caster's Attack, before activating Grace of the Battlefield.
**Grace of the Battlefield**: Grants a ++barrier++ (proportional to the **caster’s Attack**) to all allies for 2 turns, and grants ++increased Speed++ of the caster for 2 turns.

skills.name: Dragon Slayer's Strike
skills.description: Attacks **all enemies** by striking downwards with a spear and has a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Hit Chance-- for 2 turns and a {{variable}} chance to --provoke-- for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ankle Cut
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Crystal Clear Soul
skills.description:
When the ally with the highest Attack starts their turn, **gains 1 Focus**. After attacking on the caster's turn, when **Focus** is full, **consumes all Focus**, activating Glacial Strike.
**Glacial Strike**: Attacks **all enemies**, with a 50% chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns, and grants ++Torrent++ to the ally with the highest Attack.

skills.name: Frozen Winter Cut
skills.description: Attacks the enemy repeatedly, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Speed-- for 2 turns, and ++increases Speed++ of the caster for 2 turns.

skills.name: Seduction
skills.description: Attacks with a flame of seduction, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Defense-- for 2 turns.

skills.name: Spirit Absorb
skills.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to --decrease Attack-- for 2 turns, and when the enemy is defeated, **resets cooldown**. ++Increases Attack++ of the caster for 2 turns.

skills.name: Flame Kiss
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with the flame of Chatty, the magic lantern, with a {{variable}} chance each to inflict two --burn-- effects for 2 turns.

skills.name: Horizontal Slash
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword, and **absorbs** some of the damage dealt as Health. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's max Health**.

skills.name: Surpressed Desire

skills.name: Rouge Aroma
skills.description: **Dispels all buffs** from all enemies before inflicting --beguile-- and inflicting --decreased Hit Chance-- for 2 turns. **Ignores Effect Resistance** of targets with less max Health than the caster.

skills.name: Dark Shadow
skills.description: Attacks the enemy with dark energy, with a 50% chance to make the enemy --unhealable-- for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the amount of the **enemy's lost Health**.

skills.name: Die Hard
skills.description:
When attacked, **damage suffered in one attack does not exceed** {{variable}} of max Health. After an ally except for the caster attacks, when the target's Health is 30% or less, **activates Encroach**.
**Encroach**: Attacks **all enemies** by releasing dark energy, and **increases Combat Readiness** of the caster by 30%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **target's lost Health**.

skills.name: Conviction
skills.description: Inflicts lethal damage on the enemy. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts **extinction**, and inflicts **additional damage** proportional to the **caster's Attack** on **all enemies except for the target**. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **target's lost Health**.

skills.name: Weakening Blow
skills.description: Attacks the enemy, with a {{variable}} chance to --provoke-- for 1 turn. Damage dealt increases proportional to the **caster's Defense**.

skills.name: Will
skills.description: At the moment the caster is attacked, **increases Defense** of the caster. At the moment of every fourth attack suffered, ++increases Defense++ of all allies for 2 turns. The caster's increased Defense can stack up to 3 times.

skills.name: Perceptive Slash
